Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
I have a vampire with .

My devilishly crafty opponent play a Minor Curse on him.

I then go on to cancel a master (say, tend the flock) with Rewind Time played by my untapped vampire with

When do I replace the Rewind Time ? Immediatly ? Once the master is handled completely ? (I.E. if someone DI my Rewind time, do I replace the aforementioned Rewind before deciding to play a Sudden ?) Never ? When another action is ended ? I suppose "immediatly", because there is no action, so there is nothing to wait for.

Minor Curse
+1 stealth action.
Put this card on any minion. This minion's controller doesn't replace cards played by this minion until the end of the action.

Rewind Time

Usable by a ready, untapped vampire even though there is no action. Cancel a non-out-of-turn master card as it is played during any other Methuselah's master phase (no cost is paid). The Methuselah who played that card gains another master phase action.
